title: fix: omit unsupported seed from social text requests
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Removes the unsupported `seed` parameter from shared social text requests
- Keeps the existing retry and exponential-backoff behavior
- Fixes News gist generation with `gpt-5.6-terra` after the stateless Responses rollout
- Leaves image-generation seeds unchanged

gist.headline: Seeds stay in the garden
gist.blurb: The news hive stopped handing text models a seed they do not plant. Gists can now pass through gpt-5.6-terra cleanly while image seeds keep doing their pixel-growing work.
gist.summary: Removed the unsupported seed parameter from shared social text requests, restoring News gist generation with gpt-5.6-terra after the stateless Responses rollout while preserving image-generation seeds and retry backoff.
gist.impact: Social News gists can again generate through gpt-5.6-terra, with the existing exponential retry behavior intact and image outputs still using seeds as before.
gist.visual_concept: Polli tends two neighboring code-plants: one text-request plant has a small seed packet politely set aside because it does not accept seeds, while an image-generation flower pot happily keeps its seed. A CRT monitor robot watches a News gist scroll successfully, representing the repaired internal social pipeline.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot with pink blush, light blue wings, and a tiny gardener hat, carefully placing a seed packet beside a text code-plant while a neighboring image flower pot sprouts from its seed; a cheerful CRT monitor robot displays a successful News gist. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, flowers and vines, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with small pixel-font text: 'TEXT: NO SEED'.
